diagnosis: Your AI does solid work, but you rarely make it prove the work is done.
summary: Your AI does careful, solid work with the tools you set up.
But it often says done without running your tests.
Start by asking it to run the tests after every change.

dimensions.headline: You usually say what you want, rarely how to check it
dimensions.saw: Most big tasks start with a clear goal. Few say how you'll know it's done.
dimensions.impact: Two features were rebuilt after you saw the result.
dimensions.tryThis: Add pass/fail checks to every task bigger than one file.

dimensions.headline: Your main projects tell the AI what it needs
dimensions.saw: acme-api and pantry-app both have a short, current CLAUDE.md. The AI follows them without reminders.
dimensions.impact: You rarely repeat setup instructions in chat.
dimensions.tryThis: Add a CLAUDE.md to your two smaller projects.

evidence.note: Followed test and lint commands from CLAUDE.md

dimensions.headline: Saved rules mostly stick
dimensions.saw: You save useful rules, and later sessions use them.
dimensions.tryThis: Review saved memory once a month and delete what's stale.

dimensions.headline: Recurring work runs through skills
dimensions.saw: Releases and reviews run through saved skills, so the AI never relearns them.
dimensions.impact: Repeat work takes minutes, not an afternoon.
dimensions.tryThis: Share your release skill with your team.

dimensions.headline: Big tasks are split, but handoffs are loose
dimensions.saw: Large tasks get broken into steps. Outputs between steps are not checked.
dimensions.impact: One step built on a broken result.
dimensions.tryThis: Name each step's output and check it before the next one.

dimensions.headline: Failures get fixed, but nothing changes the loop
dimensions.saw: Failed checks get fixed and rerun. The same failures come back the next week.
dimensions.impact: You spend time on the same fixes.
dimensions.tryThis: Turn a repeated failure into a saved rule or check.

dimensions.headline: The AI says done without testing
dimensions.saw: The AI changed code 23 times last week. It never ran your tests once. You caught three breakages yourself, a day later.
dimensions.impact: Bugs reach you instead of the tests.
dimensions.tryThis: Make the AI run the tests after every change.

evidence.note: 23 edits, no test run, then reported done
Broken checkout found the next day

dimensions.headline: You redirect the AI with clear reasons
dimensions.saw: You stop the AI when it drifts and explain why.
dimensions.impact: Work comes back on track quickly.
dimensions.tryThis: Check that your correction actually took effect.

dimensions.headline: The AI can do more than each task needs
dimensions.saw: Every session runs with all permissions. Your `.env` file with live keys is readable.
dimensions.impact: One wrong command could leak a key or delete data.
dimensions.tryThis: Allow only the commands each task needs, and block `.env`.

dimensions.headline: Small tasks run on your biggest model
dimensions.saw: Renames, typo fixes and formatting all ran on your most expensive model. That was about a third of last week's spend.
dimensions.impact: You pay top prices for work a smaller model does just as well.
dimensions.tryThis: Send small edits to a cheaper subagent.

evidence.note: Typo fix on the top model

improvement.title: Make the AI run your tests after every change
improvement.situation: The AI changed code 23 times last week. It never ran your tests once. You caught three breakages yourself, a day later.
improvement.impact: Bugs reach you instead of the tests.
actions: Add a definition of done to CLAUDE.md.
Ask for the test output before the AI says done.
If a test fails, have it fix and rerun before stopping.
improvement.suggestedInstruction: Add this to CLAUDE.md under "Definition of done": After every code change, run `npm test` and show me the output. If anything fails, fix it and run the tests again. Don't say done until they pass.

evidence.note: 23 edits, no test run, then reported done

roadmap.change: Small tasks go to a cheaper model.
